name: Dev Activity Watcher
author: Dev Activity Watcher
description: Privacy-first developer activity tracker: today's per-app time and 7-day history for editors, AI agents, browsers, and terminals. Local by default; optional sync to your own database.

barWidget.description: Today's developer app usage at a glance with an expandable breakdown. Tracks editors, AI agents, browsers, and terminals only; data stays local unless you configure optional cloud sync.

schema.label: Dim the widget while idle
schema.description: Dims the bar item and its tooltip mentions the idle state when you are AFK.

schema.label: Bar display
schema.description: What the bar shows. Right-clicking the widget cycles through the three formats.
